sections.difficulty: Open-water lake crossing — challenging in wind and boat traffic
sections.notes: This trip continues from the Rock River into Lake Koshkonong and exits at Newville. The water-trail guide classifies the lake crossing as challenging because of its broad open water and motorboat traffic. Avoid high winds and approaching storms. Arrange a vehicle shuttle and plan for active paddling; river current alone does not determine the crossing time. The existing 11.7-mile planning distance is preliminary USGS geometry, not a surveyed or approved navigation route.
sections.accessReview: Route check pending: the Koshkonong Wetland dam record conflicts with the published Rock River water trail through this reach. Its relationship to the paddling channel needs confirmation before this map is released.
sections.routeReview: The Koshkonong Wetland barrier record remains unresolved. This trip also crosses Lake Koshkonong; no reviewed dotted path or live float time is provided.

notices.title: Lake crossing, not a simple river drift
notices.text: The Rock River Water Trail guide warns about open water, motorboat traffic, high winds and storms on Lake Koshkonong. Its approximately 11-mile description is planning context; the barrier-record conflict still needs review.
notices.sourceName: Rock River Trail Initiative — Section E guide
